name: AI video
blurb: Make, generate, edit and deliver video: HyperFrames, video-model prompts, ffmpeg cuts, captions, beat cuts and QA.
searches: new text-to-video model release API pricing
image-to-video prompting technique camera control consistency
HyperFrames release new workflow or registry blocks
AI video editing agent transcript cut ffmpeg skill
auto captions talking head short-form editing technique

tests.prompt: I have a 9-minute talking-head recording (talk.mp4) with lots of ums and two false starts. Make a 60-second vertical clip for Reels with captions. Tell me exactly what you will run and in what order.
tests.good: Probes and transcribes word-level first; proposes a cut strategy and waits for approval; cuts on word boundaries with 30-200 ms padding and 30 ms fades; reframes 9:16 before burning captions; captions last, at most 2 lines, inside the Reels safe zone; loudness -14 LUFS with true peak at or below -1 dBTP; verifies with a probe and a contact sheet.

tests.prompt: Write the prompts and settings to turn our product photo (bottle.png) into three 5-second b-roll clips for a 9:16 ad, and pick a model. The brand name must be perfectly readable.
tests.good: Uses image-to-video from the photo; one camera move per clip, varied across clips; describes motion and what stays still; keeps the brand name out of the generated layer (code overlay) or protects the label; states model, cost and number of takes before generating; credentials from environment variables only.

tests.prompt: Turn this 900-word blog post about compound interest into a 60-second narrated explainer for YouTube Shorts. Give me the plan you would get approved first.
tests.good: States a one-sentence message and 1080x1920 aspect; picks one explainer structure and does not follow paragraph order; hook in the first 3 s with the thesis by beat 2; 10-12 beats with timings that add up to about 60 s and about 140 voiceover words; on-screen numbers set in code; captions from word timings; asks for approval before rendering.

tests.prompt: Make a 45-second TikTok teaser for our note-taking app: a few AI b-roll shots of the same person sketching ideas in a cafe, a real screen recording of the app, a voiceover and a music bed, with captions. Plan the shots before generating anything.
tests.good: States a short plan first: shots through storyboarding (shot-lists-and-boards.md, keyframes-and-consistency.md: one identity string so the person stays the same), voiceover and bed through audio-generation (voiceover-tts.md, music-generation.md: about 100 words of VO, one voice, instrumental bed), then here: hybrid route (plan-and-route.md), b-roll prompts (generative-prompting.md), screen recording and assembly (explainers-and-promos.md), delivery (delivery-qa.md). Hook in 3 s; app name and UI text in code; model and cost stated before paid takes; captions last inside the TikTok safe zone; -14 LUFS; checks the Done means of all three crafts.
